name: sunday-popup
description: Live view of what the Sunday speaker hears and says

scripts.dist:mac: npm run vendor && npm run host && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run vendor && npm run host && electron-builder --win zip --x64
scripts.build:native: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 -o native/audio-playing native/audio-playing.swift && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 -o native/ear-audio native/ear-audio.swift

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Sunday listens to what this Mac is playing so the speaker can tell it apart from your voice.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sunday listens for its name on this Mac when the speaker cube can't hear you.
